title: Session Manager MCP stable error codes v1

codes.description: A tool argument has the wrong type or shape.
The requested platform is not in the server registry.
The platform is public and does not accept stored login state.
No allowed, non-expired credential remained after validation and filtering.
The credential payload, field set, value, or expiration is invalid.
The submitted credential payload or local record exceeds a configured limit.
The idempotency key does not satisfy the stable key format.
The same action and idempotency key were reused for a different request.
An idempotent replay refers to a session revision that is no longer current.
The local data path is unsafe or owner-only permissions cannot be established.
The platform secure-storage backend cannot encrypt or decrypt the local credential record.
The OpenClaw-managed browser's local CDP endpoint is not reachable; open the browser and retry (runtime responses mark this retriable).
The managed browser's CDP endpoint answered, but the cookie exchange was malformed or rejected.
An unexpected server-side failure crossed the protocol boundary.
